title: docs(changesets): say what `objectui check` does with a bare document in three pending changesets, and name `objectui validate` for the verdict (objectui#10606)
body:
Fixes #10606
Clause-②: no

Release text only. Three pending changesets told an author that `objectui check` reports a bare retired type key as unknown: `{ "type": "line-chart" }` (8760), `{ "type": "view:dashboard" }` (9533) and bare `map` (10393). `check` prints that warning only for a file it recognises. A root with no structural key that does not validate, and whose `type` is off the known-type list `check` reads, is counted as skipped, and the run exits 0. Each sentence is corrected in the objectui#10533 dated-note form, with the front matter byte-identical, and names `objectui validate` for the verdict. `check` itself is unchanged: whether it should parse the files it admits is objectui#6318's open question.

The house wording is PR objectui#10523's: `check` checks the `type` of each file it recognises, and a file whose root carries an ObjectUI structural key (`children`, `className`, `body`, …) is recognised by that key alone. A file with none of those keys is parsed against the schema. It is listed by name when its root `type` is on the known-type list and the document does not validate, and is otherwise counted as skipped. `check` exits non-zero on unreadable JSON only.

## What changed

| file | change |
| --- | --- |
| `.changeset/8760-unfulfilled-chart-stubs.md` | The **Breaking** paragraph no longer says `objectui check` reports `Unknown schema type "line-chart"`. It now says `objectui validate` refuses the document at `type` (`invalid_union`). A new `⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-25 — … — objectui#10606.**` records the correction and says what `check` does with the bare document and with a structural one. |
| `.changeset/9533-dashboard-bare-key-converge-plugin-namespace.md` | The **Breaking for authored metadata** paragraph no longer says `check` reports `{ "type": "view:dashboard" }` as unknown. It names `objectui validate` instead. In **What changed**, "`objectui check` names it rather than blessing it" is scoped to "names it in a file it recognises". One dated note, after the first paragraph, covers both sentences. |
| `.changeset/10393-retire-bare-map-key.md` | The `@object-ui/cli` bullet's "so the check now flags it" becomes "so the check now reports `map` as an unknown schema type in a file it recognises". A dated note follows the bullet list and names `objectui validate` for the verdict. Round 2: the same bullet's `view:map` clause, "and `objectui check` does not flag it", now says `check` does not report `view:map` as an unknown schema type in a file it recognises, and that a bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` is listed in `check`'s advisory did-not-validate list instead. |

Front matter md5 before (at base `5add18a67`) and after, per file, identical:

| file | md5 of the front matter block |
| --- | --- |
| `8760-unfulfilled-chart-stubs.md` | `24d9e155a9fe760e502862226ced2ba3` |
| `9533-dashboard-bare-key-converge-plugin-namespace.md` | `04b5781f09530b1c4efda2273bc5a87a` |
| `10393-retire-bare-map-key.md` | `02a248bf14464234d9665bad2c91931b` |

The 10393 md5 is the same again at the round-2 head `7467d4e39`. `check-changeset-overwrite` prints the same declared-at-base / declares-now pair for all three files (quoted under Gates).

## Measurement on base `5add18a67`

I built the CLI with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter "@object-ui/cli..." build` under the verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`). Each probe document sat alone in its own directory, and `check` ran with that directory as `cwd`.

| document | `objectui check` over its directory | `objectui validate FILE` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{ "type": "line-chart" }` | `Skipped 1 file with a root "type" that no ObjectUI recogniser admitted.`, then `✓ All checks passed`, exit 0. No unknown-type line. | exit 1: `Path: type`, `Code: invalid_union`, `No arm accepts type "line-chart".` |
| control `{ "type": "line-chart", "className": "h-64" }` | `⚠️ Unknown schema type "line-chart" in line-chart-structural.json`, exit 0 | exit 1, same error |
| `{ "type": "view:dashboard" }` | `Skipped 1 file …`, exit 0. No unknown-type line. | exit 1: `Path: type`, `Code: invalid_union`, `No arm accepts type "view:dashboard".` |
| control `{ "type": "view:dashboard", "className": "h-64" }` | `⚠️ Unknown schema type "view:dashboard" in view-dashboard-structural.json`, exit 0 | exit 1, same error |
| `{ "type": "map" }` | `Skipped 1 file …`, exit 0. No unknown-type line. | exit 1: `Path: type`, `Code: invalid_union`, `No arm accepts type "map".` |
| control `{ "type": "map", "className": "h-64" }` | `⚠️ Unknown schema type "map" in map-structural.json`, exit 0 | exit 1, same error |

`validate` refuses all three bare documents at `type`. It does not name a replacement spelling. Its "Nearest … accepted types" hint lists `chart` for `line-chart` and `dashboard` for `view:dashboard`, and nothing close to `object-map` for `map`. So the corrected sentences say only that `validate` refuses the document at `type` (`invalid_union`) and exits non-zero.

## Why "corrected", not "at this change"

None of the three sentences was ever true of the bare document it quotes. The recognition gate landed before all three changes: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 7dc08a3e7 X` exits 0 for X = `6a4680b57` (8760), `e356c39ee` (9533) and `64563a915` (10393). `7dc08a3e7` is the validity-recogniser commit (objectui#6322), and it sits on top of the marker gate. Exit 0 is self-proving, so no control leg is needed; the checkout is not shallow. At each of those commits `check.ts` has the `OBJECTUI_STRUCTURAL_KEYS.some((key) => key in content) ||` recogniser and the `skipped++` branch. So I followed #10595's route for sentences that were never true: the sentence is corrected, and the dated note records the correction. The objectui#10533 "at this change" scoping would have asserted a false history.

## H4: other pending changesets that name `check` near a diagnostic

Sweeps, run against `origin/main`, with both the file list and the contents read from that ref:

1. The dispatch grep `git grep -n -E "objectui check|\bcheck\b.*(reports|flags|refuses|Unknown schema type)" origin/main -- .changeset`.
2. A paragraph-level node scan across line breaks: a paragraph that names the CLI (`objectui check`, backticked `check`, `the check`, `check command`) together with `unknown`, `flag`, `warn`, `report`, `names it`, `bless` or `unrecognised`. It matched 25 paragraphs. I re-ran it at main `98b1a7cac` after fetching, and it matched the same 25.
3. `git grep -i -E "unknown schema type|unknown-type|as unknown|flags? (it|them|the|a|bare)"` over `.changeset/` at main `98b1a7cac`.

The test for each hit: does it promise a `check` diagnostic on a document with no structural root key? Every hit I read, with its verdict:

| hit | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| `8760` **Breaking** paragraph | changed (above) |
| `9533` **Breaking** paragraph, and "names it rather than blessing it" in **What changed** | changed (above) |
| `10393` `@object-ui/cli` bullet, "so the check now flags it" | changed (above) |
| `10393` same bullet, `view:map` "`objectui check` does not flag it" | changed in round 2. A bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` is flagged by name in the advisory did-not-validate list, so the absence claim was false. |
| `8802` "`objectui check` will NOT flag either namespaced spelling" | stands. It claims an absence and promises no diagnostic. |
| `unknown-component-type-case-suggestion-5247` "`objectui check` reports `Unknown schema type "Page" in FILE — did you mean "page"?`" | stands. It gives the text of the warning, framed as "both surfaces that report the miss", and quotes no document. (Here `FILE` stands for the angle-bracket placeholder the entry prints, which GitHub deletes from a body.) |
| `9641` (four paragraphs: "Stop `objectui check` reporting five real page types as unknown", and so on) | stands. It describes a false positive being removed and promises no diagnostic. |
| `check-schema-positive-marker-and-skip-count` (two paragraphs), `6075`, `7004`, `6074` | stand. They describe the marker gate, the validity recogniser and the skip count themselves. |
| `8499` "**Downstream.** `objectui check` stops reporting these documents", `7113` (`chart: 2` census), `6939` ("counts four for this row") | stand. They are about the advisory list; #10595 read them the same way. |
| `6051`, `8344`, `7546` | stand. They say `check` / `validate` call `safeValidateSchema`, which is true of the validity arm. |
| `7694`, `10478`, `6475`, `8466`, `8505`, `8572`, `9239`, `9511`, `9559`, `9746`, `10524` | #10595 already reconciled these (the validation-verdict family, `objectui#10524` dated notes). None of them promises the unknown-type warning on a bare document. |
| `6320` | stands. It is about the glob ignore list. |
| `6143`, `6296`, `6426`, `6559`, `6577`, `7122`, `7282`, `7804`, `8557`, `9126`, `9497`, `9653`, `9659`, `9743`, `9922`, `curly-hoops-attack`, `issue-5709-…`, `nine-holdouts-six-narrow`, `tidy-pumas-repeat` | not the CLI. They name another `check*` script, a gate or the plain word. |

So no H4 hit beyond the three named files.

## Gates at head `c9ef2ce5d`

The diff touches only `.changeset/*.md`. No workspace package changed, so there is no dependency-closure build and no package `type-check` or test run to owe. The CLI build above was for the measurement only. The families below come from objectui's own `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`: `changeset-guard.yml` (no-major, overwrite), `changeset-presence.yml` (presence, claims), `ci.yml` (fixed), `control-bytes.yml`, `line-citation-gate.yml`, and the `check:*` scripts that read `.changeset/**`.

| gate | verdict line | exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | `✅  No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` (report-only) | `⚠️  This change touches 3 changeset(s) it did not add`. For all 3 files the declared-at-base line equals the declares-now line. | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | ``✅  No changeset declares a `major` bump.`` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` | `✅  All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group.` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs` (report-only) | `✅  Every package declared across those 3 body(ies) is either not negated …` and `✅  No pending changeset names a file this change touches.` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | `✅  check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 8726 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | `✅  No test source names a pending changeset.` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:installed-pin-claims` | `OK` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape` | `✅  check-vi-mock-override-shape: OK …` | 0 |
| `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --changed` (the three paths) | lists all three: they fall under the `.changeset/**` input class of `check-changeset-no-major.test.ts` and `dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts` | 0 |

The two tests that read `.changeset/**`, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-no-major.test.ts scripts/__tests__/dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts` under the verify lock: `Test Files  2 passed (2)`, `Tests  44 passed (44)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

`git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` (main at `98b1a7cac`) exits 0. Main has not changed any of the three files since base.

H5: overwrite gate route. #10595 cleared `check-changeset-overwrite` as report-only (its PR body quotes the same `⚠️  This change touches 11 changeset(s) it did not add` line, exit 0). No allow-list, no trailer and no gate label was involved. `changeset-guard.yml` runs the script without `OS_CHANGESET_OVERWRITE_ENFORCE`. This PR takes the same route: case 2 of the script's own text, "prose that no longer matches the change". No pin is owed: this PR changes changeset prose only.

## Round 2, head `7467d4e39`

The contract review of `c9ef2ce5d` found one false sentence, and measured it. In `10393`, the `view:map` clause "and `objectui check` does not flag it" was false for a bare document. `{ "type": "view:map" }` prints the advisory header `⚠️ 1 file carries a registered ObjectUI component type but did not validate as an ObjectUI schema:`, then `view-map.json (type "view:map")` on the next line, exit 0. With `"className": "h-64"` it prints nothing. The clause now reads, rewrapped to the file's width: "and `objectui check` does not report it as an unknown schema type in a file it recognises. A bare `{ "type": "view:map" }` with no structural key is listed in `check`'s advisory did-not-validate list instead, because `view:map` is on the known-type list and `AnyComponentSchema` has no arm for it; that line does not say the node renders a placeholder. Search documents for `view:map` directly." `packages/types/src/` has no `view:map` literal (positive control: `object-map` has 3 hits in `zod/objectql.zod.ts`). The file's dated note already says a non-validating file is listed by name when its `type` is on the known-type list, so it agrees with the new clause and is unchanged. Front matter md5 `02a248bf14464234d9665bad2c91931b` at `5add18a67`, `c9ef2ce5d`, `7467d4e39` and `3f0f8eca3`.

Round 3, head `3f0f8eca3`: "because `view:map` is on that list" became "because `view:map` is on the known-type list". "That list" followed the advisory did-not-validate list and could be read as naming it. No other byte changed. At that head, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-control-bytes` print the same verdict lines as in the table below, each with exit 0. `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` (main at `f99f9cde7`) exits 0.

| gate at `7467d4e39` | verdict line | exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | `✅  No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed.` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | ``✅  No changeset declares a `major` bump.`` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | `✅  check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 8726 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary).` | 0 |
| the two `.changeset/**`-reading tests, under the verify lock | `Test Files  2 passed (2)`, `Tests  44 passed (44)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` | 0 |

`git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` (main at `4a3d500fd`) exits 0. Main has not changed any of the three files since base.

## Acceptance notes

These are not filed.

- This one is read from source and not measured. At each change's parent, the retired key was on the CLI's known-type list (`known-schema-types.ts` has the literal at `6a4680b57^`, `e356c39ee^` and `64563a915^`), and `packages/types/src/zod/` has no literal for it. So the same bare document was then most likely listed in the advisory "did not validate" list, and the retirement moved it into the silent skipped count. That bears on objectui#6318's open question and is not acted on here.
